t: These are numbers 38 to 43 Russell Square, part of a nineteenth-century terrace in Bloomsbury. The man credited with designing them is James Burton, who was less an architect than a developer. He was the most successful property developer of Regency and Georgian London, building over three thousand properties across 250 acres. Between 1792 and 1802 he spent over four hundred thousand pounds on the Foundling Hospital Estate alone. So this terrace is one small piece of a much larger London he helped build.
